NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION - LEVEL OF CARE, INPATIENT VERSUS OBSERVATION

This letter is to advise you that Meridian Health Plan has completed a level of care review of the above referenced admission and has issued an adverse determination regarding inpatient level of care. The requested inpatient level of care is not approved. Observation level of care is the level supported by the submitted documentation.

Basis for Determination

The review was conducted using the InterQual-style criteria set applied by this plan. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

Criteria codes not met and the findings applied:

SEP-01: Laboratory and vital sign findings did not show sepsis with persistent instability after initial treatment.

SEP-02: Blood pressure responded to initial fluids without persistent hypotension.

Claim Adjustment Codes

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

This adverse determination is a level of care determination, inpatient versus observation, and is issued on that basis only.

Appeal Rights

A Level 1 appeal may be submitted by letter or by portal upload. The appeal should cite the applicable criteria codes inline, specifically SEP-01 and SEP-02, and should state the clinical basis on which the inpatient level of care is asserted. Please attach the History and Physical and the progress notes for the admission. Submissions are subject to a five page limit, excluding the attached records identified above. Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that time may not be eligible for review.

The treating provider may request to discuss this level of care determination with the reviewing physician. This notice reflects a coverage determination under the terms of the member's benefit plan and is not medical advice. The treating provider remains responsible for all treatment decisions.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Meridian Health Plan
